independence.record_adapter: maps recorded steps and terminal next bounds only; never computes replacement search states, answers or counts

reviewed_properties: Bounded dense integer arrays are copied and checked for nondecreasing order without sorting or editing caller data.
Every recorded midpoint, ordering relation and next-boundary pair matches the prescribed half-open lower-bound algorithm.
All frames preserve prefix < target, suffix >= target, the closed possible-boundary interval, and strict shrink per ordering comparison.
The final position is the independent linear scan's first qualifying boundary, including n and the empty-array boundary.
Membership is a separate equality fact; comparisons counts recorded ordering decisions only.
The input parser refuses malformed, sparse, unsorted, noninteger and out-of-bound cases; frozen callers and signed-zero values remain exact.
scope_limits: These are two executions of the same frozen controls in distinct environments; their counts are not summed.
The oracle's deliberately bad trace controls are checker self-tests, not an observed failing production baseline.
The reviewer authored only the separate HTML/CSS template and makes no independent acceptance claim for that authored template.
UI, builder, browser behavior, actual downloads and importer/course behavior are outside this helper review; no such tests were repeated here.
The native commit is explicitly a bounded source capture, not authenticated public-main ancestry.
